title: Apify ATS Open Roles on a schedule
description: Run the Apify actor transparent_meteorite/ats-open-roles (open jobs from Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby and other career sites (set monitorMode for new-or-changed)) on a schedule and pass each result row to your next step.
disclosure: Disclosure: I maintain the Apify actor this workflow calls (Apify account transparent_meteorite). The workflow itself is free to use; the actor is a paid pay-per-event Apify actor, with free-plan credit covering a trial.

steps.note: Webhooks by Zapier is a paid-plan app. The response is a JSON array; Zapier exposes it as a line-item list.

fields.values_to_loop: map the array items you need from step 2

setup: Create the Zap with the four steps above.
Paste your own Apify API token in the Authorization header (never share it).
Edit data to your own filters.
Test step 2 once, then turn the Zap on.
Check the actor's Store page for per-result pricing before scheduling.
